description.narrative: project is designed to improve the enabling environment for, and increase the availability and use of, high-impact health services, products, and practices for family planning; (FP); maternal, newborn and child health (MNCH); nutrition; malaria; neglected tropical diseases (NTDs); tuberculosis (TB); HIV/AIDS; and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) in target health zones.
